title: Remove apps completely with mole
summary: Use mole to uninstall applications and their associated files completely from your Mac, ensuring no leftover data remains.

steps.explain: Run mole uninstall to remove applications and their associated files from your Mac.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command for mole uninstall. You would need to reinstall the application.

warnings: This command removes applications and their data. Ensure you want to permanently delete the selected apps.
